nodes.label: JPMS Module com.maybeitssquid.safeascii
nodes.rationale: Named module enables SPI registration and clean package separation of public API from internal pipeline

nodes.label: CharsetProvider SPI Registration Pattern
nodes.rationale: Dual registration via module-info.java and META-INF/services enables both module path and classpath discovery

nodes.label: Unicode Transliteration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Chain-of-responsibility pattern with Cache, Decompose, Name, and ASCIIFilter stages; Single-Byte variant adds length validation for fixed-width output

nodes.label: Fixed-Width Record Format Requirement
nodes.rationale: Single-Byte charset guarantees 1:1 character output to prevent shifting fields in ACH and similar record formats

nodes.label: CRLF Newline Normalization
nodes.rationale: X-ASCII-Plain and X-ASCII-Formatted normalize CRLF to LF to handle Windows and EBCDIC newline variants safely across platforms

nodes.label: Spotless Google Java Format Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Automated formatting via Spotless enforces consistency and style, with module-info.java exclusion for flexibility

nodes.label: Gradle-Git-Version Release Automation
nodes.rationale: Git tags drive version derivation automatically, eliminating manual version management and enabling CI/CD automation

nodes.label: OWASP Dependency Check Security Gate
nodes.rationale: Build-time CVE detection and CVSS >= 7 failure threshold prevents publishing vulnerable transitive dependencies

nodes.label: Java 25 Toolchain with Java 17 Bytecode Target
nodes.rationale: Latest toolchain for development and testing, Java 17 bytecode ensures compatibility with modern LTS releases (17, 21, 25)
nodes.norm_label: java 25 toolchain with java 17 bytecode target
